reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 16 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets (confidence).
Bottom line: the Lakers win 87 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 192 and 241 total points.
